primary_metrics.minimal_positive_set_F1: exact F1 over antichain-minimal positive binary masks at reference slice
primary_metrics.phase_region_IoU: IoU of 5x5 continuous positive region on factorized phase map

preregistered_hypotheses.H4_relative: Generalized MEES v0.2 mean structural_score exceeds best frozen baseline by >= 0.15
preregistered_hypotheses.H5_anchor: at least 5/6 selected anchors are true binary positives under hidden ground truth

verdict_rule: PASS only if H1-H5 all pass.
scope: Factorable binary-design × continuous-phase benchmark family; not arbitrary causal systems.
stop_rule: If v0.2 fails overall, do not tune on METHOD-4; restrict the methodological claim or build a separately motivated v0.3 only with a new future holdout.
